outcome: contact with child protection agencies (CSC) during pregnancy
cohort: A cohort of 36,322 singleton pregnancy records from linked electronic health records in South London (eLIXIR-BiSL cohort) was studied.
finding: Socio-economic and ethnic disparities were observed, with CSC contact during pregnancy most frequently associated with Black and multiparous women, those living in poorer socio-economic circumstances, and those with various medical, obstetric, and psychiatric comorbidities.
